statements.quote: Revenue for the three months ended September 30, 2024 was $43.7 million compared to $21.7 million in the prior year period, and consisted of $11.6 million in Digital Asset Mining revenue, $20.8 million in Managed Services revenue, $3.4 million in High Performance Computing – Colocation and Cloud revenue, and $7.9 million in Other revenue.
statements.notes: Figure covers only Q3 2024 (three months ended September 30, 2024), not the full fiscal year. The High Performance Computing – Colocation and Cloud segment is treated here as data-center/AI revenue. GPU-as-a-Service revenue is separately folded into 'Other' and is not broken out.
